verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own materials directly claim the core capability. Sessions can be created programmatically through an SDK and API, the platform says it can 'spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions,' and its agents pull data from websites, including price and listing tracking. That covers concurrency, scraping and scale, but only at the level of marketing and overview claims. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or plan quotas, detailed scaling or reliability guidance (rate limits, retries, throughput), and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale concurrent scraping.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can spin up many concurrent scraping sessions to gather data at scale
